title: Grilled Chicken Bowl with Cauliflower Rice and Roasted Sweet Potato
blurb: A nourishing bowl with marinated chicken breast, golden roasted sweet potato, wilted kale and lightly spiced cauliflower rice.
steps: Preheat your oven to 200°C and cut the sweet potato into small cubes, toss with half the olive oil and a pinch of salt, then spread on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes until tender and golden.
Meanwhile, mix the lemon juice, crushed garlic, a pinch of salt and pepper in a shallow dish, add the chicken breast and turn to coat, then leave to marinate while the sweet potato cooks.

Heat a griddle pan or frying pan over medium-high heat, remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through with no pink meat remaining, then set aside to rest.
In the same pan, add the riced cauliflower and cumin with a splash of water, season with salt and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until just tender.
Add the chopped kale to the cauliflower for the final minute of cooking, stirring until wilted.
Slice the chicken breast and arrange in a bowl with the cauliflower rice, kale and roasted sweet potato cubes.
